Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “mostly produced” and overrode the well-established fact that British Burma was famed for producing the majority of the world’s teak (about 75%). They pivoted to gurjan based on a niche “fellings-by-volume” nuance rather than the intended production/export prominence, leading to an incorrect final answer.
